There are two `NotificationChannel` interfaces — one in the `monitoring` module and one in the `application` module. Here are all implementing classes:

RELEVANT_FILES_START
subjects/thingsboard/repo/monitoring/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/monitoring/notification/channels/impl/SlackNotificationChannel.java | implements monitoring NotificationChannel
subjects/thingsboard/repo/application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/MicrosoftTeamsNotificationChannel.java | implements application NotificationChannel<MicrosoftTeamsNotificationTargetConfig, MicrosoftTeamsDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
subjects/thingsboard/repo/application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/SmsNotificationChannel.java | implements application NotificationChannel<User, SmsDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
subjects/thingsboard/repo/application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/EmailNotificationChannel.java | implements application NotificationChannel<User, EmailDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
subjects/thingsboard/repo/application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/MobileAppNotificationChannel.java | implements application NotificationChannel<User, MobileAppDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
subjects/thingsboard/repo/application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/SlackNotificationChannel.java | implements application NotificationChannel<SlackConversation, SlackDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
subjects/thingsboard/repo/application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/DefaultNotificationCenter.java | implements application NotificationChannel<User, WebDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate> (also implements NotificationCenter)
RELEVANT_FILES_END
